channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Kerala Suicide Case: Shimjitha Musthafa Detained in Kozhikode Over Alleged Abetment of Deepak’s Suicide
item.description: Kerala: Shimjitha Musthafa was taken into custody in Kozhikode following the tragic suicide of a youth named Deepak.

item.title: Logical Take: Athletes Retire, Injuries Don’t: India’s Missing Safety Net for Sportspersons
item.description: India’s retired athletes face chronic injuries, financial uncertainty, and mental health struggles due to inadequate post-career support.

item.title: Bengal Elderly Man Dies After SIR Notices to Him, Six Deaths Show Democracy’s Human Cost and Fear
item.description: A series of deaths allegedly linked to anxiety over electoral roll revisions has triggered political outrage and calls for empathy-driven governance in West Bengal.

item.title: A Split-Second Mistake, a Lifetime Impact: Delhi Tribunal Awards ₹84.5 Lakh for Negligent Car Door Opening
item.description: A Delhi tribunal held a driver negligent for opening a car door without warning, awarding ₹84.5 lakh to a young motorcyclist left 90% disabled.

item.title: Tearful Moment: Single Father’s Emotional Appeal for Daughter in Gorakhpur School Moves the Nation
item.description: A viral video from Gorakhpur shows a widowed father pleading with a teacher for his daughter's care.

item.title: “Store Food for 5 Days, Weapons, Batteries”: Greenland Urges Citizens to Prepare for Crisis Amid Trump’s Renewed Threats
item.description: Greenland has urged citizens to prepare emergency supplies as Trump’s renewed Arctic ambitions spark diplomatic unease and global concern.

item.title: ‘I Don’t Think I Will Return To India’: American Woman Alleges Harassment By Teen on Delhi Metro
item.description: An American tourist’s Delhi Metro visit ended in trauma after a teenager’s family allegedly excused his groping.

item.title: No Alerts, No Answers: Over 13 SpiceJet Flights Cancelled at Chennai Airport, Over 200 Passengers Stranded
item.description: Over 200 travellers were left stranded at Chennai airport after sudden SpiceJet cancellations and delays, raising fresh concerns over airline accountability and passenger communication.

item.title: Cyber Fraud in Bengaluru: Techie Loses ₹5 Lakh After Clicking Fake Website Link to Clear ₹500 Traffic Challan
item.description: A Bengaluru software professional lost ₹5 lakh after clicking a fake traffic challan link, highlighting the growing threat of e-challan phishing scams across India.

item.title: Meet Padma Shri Dr Tapan Kumar Lahiri: The Varanasi Surgeon Treating Poor Patients for Free for Decades
item.description: The 85 year old surgeon Dr Tapan Kumar Lahiri treats thousands for free, refusing any salary since 1994.
